prompt: Who among the people who proposed the three-stage system in an article titled "Stone Age Cultures of South Africa" was a civil engineer?
answer: Clarence (Peter) van Riet Lowe was the civil engineer. He co-authored *Stone Age Cultures of South Africa* with archaeologist A. J. H. Goodwin.
